newsitem.title: USA: MBNA Corp Q1 shr rises to $0.34.
newsitem.headline: MBNA Corp Q1 shr rises to $0.34.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q1 net interest income: $180.8 million vs $151.2 million.
Q1 provision for possible credit loasses $58.4 million vs $49.5 million.

1996 Q1 includes a $32.8 million tax benefit related to amortization of customer based intangible assets related to the company's initial public offering and a charge of $32.8 million related to debut of Platinum Plus credit cards.
Share figures reflect three-for-two stock split issued January 1, 1997.
Total assets at March 31: $18.1 billion vs $13.5 billion.
Net loans as of March 31: $6.69 billion vs $5.14 billion.
Total deposits as of March 31: $10.91 billion vs $8.98 billion.
